verdict.rationale: Fivetran's core product is scheduled, recurring data syncs (down to 1-minute intervals) plus orchestrated transformations, and its REST API/MCP server let an AI-native user programmatically manage, trigger, and monitor these recurring pipelines (e.g., checking sync status, copying connections, write/delete operations). This directly satisfies 'schedule recurring jobs/workflows' for the data-pipeline domain.  Missing for 10: explicit documentation of arbitrary cron-style custom job scheduling beyond connector sync frequency, and independent hands-on confirmation that scheduled syncs run reliably (community reports mention occasional sync drift/re-sync needs).
